ABOUT SPY VS. SPY (NES)

Join the feud between the Black Spy and the White Spy in SPY VS SPY. Pick a spy and set booby traps throughout the level to stop your nemesis. When he is incapacitated, try to grab the five items hidden throughout the stage. However, you must be careful and not get caught in a trap yourself. Find out who the most clever spy is with SPY VS SPY. From the MAD magazine comic strip; two playable characters; set traps for the enemy; collect five hidden objects; ifinite traps and lives.
